_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. an environment sheet of a garage apartment studio from three angles plus detail insets: cedar-shingle walls, corrugated tin ceiling, splintered fir floorboards, a drafting table with a green enameled swing-arm lamp under a small wood-mullioned casement window, three jars on the sill (brushes, nibs, a sand dollar), a cinderblock bookcase, numbered banker's boxes, a wicker wastebasket, a crowded corkboard, an old comic strip pinned to the wall, a braided wool dog bed under the table; inset: the porch with three cedar steps and an aluminum storm door; labeled THE GARAGE. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
